wav.path: mix.wav (synthetic: loud tone 0.2-1.4 s as caller, 5x quieter tone 1.8-2.8 s as background)

time_fields.t: monotonic seconds since run start, at event receipt
time_fields.audio_pos_s: seconds of audio pushed when the event was received (includes tail silence)

server_config.note: scripted fake server from tests/fake_riva.py, not a real ASR

asr_config_file.note: file as passed to this tool; the running riva_server may use another config
asr_config_file.content:
# NeMo-Speech.cpp riva_server config for Apple Silicon (Metal).
#
#   riva_server --config config/asr.mac.yaml --bind 127.0.0.1:50051
#
# Keys are documented in NeMo-Speech.cpp docs/asr/configuration.md. Unknown keys
# are a hard error. The same file works on a Linux/CUDA server (gpu = CUDA index).
asr:
  backend:
    gpu: 0                       # Metal device; -1 = CPU

  model:
    # nvidia/nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b (Q8 GGUF). Pre-download with
    # `nemo-speech pull nemotron-en`, or put an absolute .gguf path here.
    path: nemotron-en

  streaming:
    rnnt_right_context: 1        # low-latency preset; -1 = model max (more accurate, more latency)

  vad:
    # Silero VAD GGUF (see README, one-off conversion). Masks non-speech before
    # the encoder, which removes words hallucinated from noise.
    # model_path: /absolute/path/to/silero-v6.2.0.gguf
    masker:
      mask_enable: false         # set true together with model_path

  endpointing:
    enable: true                 # required: LiveKit keeps one stream open and needs mid-stream finals
    vad_based: false             # true once vad.model_path is set
    stop_history_eou_ms: 700     # trailing silence that closes a final

  diar:
    # Streaming Sortformer v2 (4 speakers, CC-BY-4.0). Alternative:
    # nemotron-3-diarization (V3, 8 speakers, 10 ms frames; preset v3-streaming).
    model_path: sortformer
    preset: streaming
